jobs.title: Strategic Operations Lead, Public Sector
jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Strategic Operations Lead, Public Sector serves as a force multiplier for Socure's Public Sector business, supporting federal, state, and local government agencies—as well as education and healthcare institutions—as they modernize identity verification and combat fraud.

Reporting to the General Manager of Public Sector, you'll operate as a strategic partner and chief of staff, driving go-to-market execution, operational excellence, AI-enabled workflows, and cross-functional initiatives that accelerate growth. This is an ideal role for someone from consulting, finance, government, GovTech, or civic technology who thrives in ambiguity and wants broad exposure to senior leadership in a high-growth, pre-IPO environment.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


REVENUE & CUSTOMER EXECUTION

 - Lead execution of key customer and revenue initiatives, including quarterly business reviews, agency briefings, contract renewals, proof-of-value and pilot readouts, and RFP responses.

 - Support renewal and recompete strategies through pricing analysis, financial modeling, scenario planning, and risk assessment.

 - Identify expansion opportunities through agency, program, and market analysis.

 - Develop executive-ready materials that translate customer, policy, and technical requirements into clear recommendations.


BUSINESS OPERATIONS & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL EXECUTION

 - Partner across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Legal to drive execution across complex public sector sales cycles.

 - Own key operating cadences, including deal reviews, forecasting, internal QBRs, leadership meetings, and all-hands.

 - Track priorities, dependencies, and follow-ups while proactively identifying and resolving blockers.

 - Improve reporting, workflows, and cross-functional processes to increase operational efficiency and visibility.


STRATEGY & LEADERSHIP ENABLEMENT

 - Build scalable operating systems, dashboards, AI-enabled workflows, and automation to improve execution.

 - Serve as a strategic thought partner to Public Sector leadership, driving high-impact initiatives from concept through execution.

 - Conduct ad hoc strategic, financial, and operational analysis to support business decisions.

 - Bring structure to ambiguity by balancing strategic planning with day-to-day execution.




WHAT YOU BRING

We're looking for a strategic operator who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and enjoys solving complex business challenges. We welcome candidates from a variety of high-performing backgrounds, including:




STRATEGY, FINANCE & BUSINESS OPERATIONS

You may have experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, strategic finance, or another highly analytical operating role. You're comfortable working with senior stakeholders, building executive-ready analyses, and turning data into actionable recommendations.




GOVERNMENT & PUBLIC SECTOR

You may come from state, local, or federal government as a budget analyst, program manager, project manager, strategy lead, chief of staff, or legislative staffer. You understand procurement cycles, appropriations, stakeholder management, and the operational realities of delivering programs in the public sector—particularly within identity, benefits, fraud prevention, tax administration, workforce, or citizen services.




PUBLIC SECTOR CONSULTING & GOVTECH

You may have advised or partnered with government agencies through organizations such as Deloitte, Booz Allen Hamilton, Accenture Federal Services, Guidehouse, ICF, or a GovTech company. Experience supporting RFPs, agency relationships, public sector modernization, procurement, or regulated industries is highly valued.




DIGITAL GOVERNMENT & CIVIC TECHNOLOGY

You may come from organizations such as 18F, the U.S. Digital Service, state or local digital service teams, or civic technology organizations. This includes chiefs of staff, strategic operators, and program leaders who have helped scale organizations, improve operations, and coordinate across executive leadership, product, engineering, policy, and go-to-market teams.




CORE SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

Regardless of your background, you'll be successful in this role if you bring:

 - 2–4 years of experience (or 1–2 years post-MBA) in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

 - Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to create executive-ready presentations and recommendations.

 - Exceptional project management and stakeholder management skills across cross-functional teams.

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities across long, complex sales and procurement cycles.

 - Familiarity with government procurement, contracting, RFPs, or regulated industries is a plus.

 - High attention to detail, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - Ability to bring structure to ambiguity while balancing strategic thinking with execution.

Direct public sector experience is a plus but not required. We're ultimately looking for curious, high-performing operators who are eager to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful business impact.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT SOCURE

We hire curious builders who:

 - Take ownership and operate with a founder mentality.

 - Stay deeply customer-focused and connect their work to revenue and mission outcomes.

 - Thrive in ambiguity and move quickly to solve problems.

 - Continuously learn, iterate, and improve.

 - Understand how Product, Go-to-Market, Data Science, and Operations work together to drive results.

 - Build trust across teams while creating scalable, efficient ways of working.




WHY THIS ROLE

 - Partner directly with the General Manager of Public Sector and senior GTM leadership.

 - Operate as the strategic right hand and chief of staff to a growing business segment.

 - Build broad experience across strategy, revenue, customer execution, finance, and operations.

 - Help shape one of Socure's fastest-growing, mission-driven businesses.

 - Develop deep expertise in public sector identity, fraud prevention, and digital modernization.

 - Position yourself for future leadership opportunities across strategy, operations, revenue, or general management.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.

jobs.title: Compliance Operations Manager
jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.




COMPLIANCE OPERATIONS MANAGER



ABOUT THE ROLE



The line between compliance and technology is disappearing. Financial institutions no longer treat AML programs as a checkbox exercise — they are demanding platforms that embed regulatory intelligence directly into their screening, monitoring, and investigation workflows. Socure is building that platform, and we are looking for a Compliance Operations Manager to be the compliance mind behind it.



This role sits at the center of a four-way intersection: the evolving regulatory landscape, our product and technology teams, our go-to-market motion, and our customers' compliance programs. You will be the compliance partner to engineering and data science, developing the rigorous frameworks, taxonomies, and methodologies that power the context layer underlying our AML platform and features. As regulations evolve — across OFAC, FATF, FinCEN, and international equivalents — you will translate that landscape into product strategy and help shape what Socure builds next.



Beyond internal product work, you will help build Socure's professional services and advisory capability: a program designed to help our customers develop and mature their own AML programs using Socure's platform. You will shape the structure of that program, the partnerships that extend its reach, and the operational model that makes it scalable — positioning Socure as a true compliance partner, not just a technology vendor.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Compliance Frameworks & Context Layer



 - Maintain rigorous frameworks, taxonomies, and methodologies that power the compliance context layer underlying Socure's AML platform — including country risk ratings, sanctions type classification, PEP categorization, and adverse media signal standards – as regulatory guidance, customer requirements, and global coverage expand.

 - Partner with Data Science and Engineering to ensure compliance intelligence is accurately represented in Watchlist's data ingestion, entity resolution, and matching systems.

 - Maintain and evolve these frameworks leveraging the latest technologies to scale this context layer



Regulatory Intelligence & Product Strategy



 - Track developments across OFAC, FATF, FinCEN, and international frameworks and translating them into product and roadmap implications.

 - Partner with Product and GTM to shape how regulatory changes become product features, positioning, and customer communications.

 - Engage with regulators, industry bodies, and compliance associations to keep Socure at the forefront of the evolving compliance ecosystem.



Professional Services & Customer Advisory



 - Help design and build Socure's professional services and advisory capability — a program that helps customers develop and mature their AML programs using Socure's platform.

 - Define the structure, partnerships, and operational model that make the advisory program scalable across Socure's growing customer base.

 - Work with Sales and Customer Success to deploy compliance advisory as a differentiator in enterprise deals and customer retention.



Cross-Functional Collaboration



 - Act as the compliance subject matter expert across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Customer Success.

 - Support enterprise deals with compliance due diligence, RFP responses, and regulatory inquiry support.

 - Interface directly with customers on complex compliance questions, audit support, and program design guidance.

 - Drive the product roadmap requirements for features that reduce operational complexity for our customers.

 - Develop smart automations using AI and agents that reduce operational burden for our cross-functional partners.



WHAT YOU BRING



 - 5–7 years of experience in AML compliance operations, sanctions screening, or financial crime operations at a financial institution, fintech, or compliance technology company.

 - Working knowledge of OFAC sanctions programs, FATF guidance, BSA/AML regulations, and PEP screening standards.

 - Experience maintaining or auditing watchlist and sanctions data sources, including list provenance tracking and quality control.

 - Familiarity with GRC frameworks and AML taxonomy structures: sanctions type classification, PEP categories, adverse media signals, and country risk ratings.

 - Hands-on technical operator that is able to leverage technology to improve customer experience and scale operations.

 - Strong attention to detail and ability to manage operational processes with rigorous documentation.

 - Effective communicator across technical (Engineering, Data Science) and non-technical (Sales, Compliance Buyers) stakeholders.

 - CAMS certification or equivalent AML compliance credential preferred.




You must be located in one of our talent hubs: New York, San Francisco, Seattle, or Miami.




Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.



Job Summary

The Program Manager, Organizational Effectiveness & Insights is a strategic, hands-on program owner responsible for designing, running, and continuously improving the programs and diagnostics that keep Socure organizationally healthy as it scales.

Reporting to the Head of Talent Development & OE, this role owns end-to-end delivery of Socure’s engagement survey program, supports operating model design and implementation work, builds and applies org health diagnostics, and develops Socure’s change management practice and playbook. The ideal candidate is a strong program manager and people analytics practitioner who can move fluidly between data, diagnosis, and design — turning insight into structured, well-adopted action.

Job Responsibilities

 - Own end-to-end execution of Socure’s engagement survey program — lifecycle surveys (onboarding, engagement/pulse, exit, etc.) — from survey design and vendor/tool management through roll-out communications, reporting, analysis, and action planning with People Partners and people leaders.

 - Consolidate engagement, pulse, exit, and other listening data into clear reporting views and dashboards; identify trends and drivers, and track action-plan progress over time.

 - Support the design, refinement, and rollout of Socure’s operating model work — role definitions, decision rights, team structure optimization, and ways of working — including facilitation, documentation, and change management for operating model shifts that come out of strategic planning.

 - Build and maintain org health diagnostics — a defined set of metrics and dashboards (e.g., turnover, span of control, engagement, performance distribution, headcount health) that give leadership an ongoing read on organizational health — and translate findings into recommendations through root-cause analysis.

 - Develop and own Socure’s change management practice: a standard playbook, toolkit, and set of frameworks (readiness assessment, stakeholder mapping, communication planning, adoption tracking) applied consistently across org changes, new program launches, and restructures.

 - Partner with the AI Ops Committee, HRBPs, and business leaders to assess how AI is reshaping team workflows and operating models — identifying where roles, processes, or org structures need to evolve — and translate those shifts into recommendations, org health diagnostics, and change management support.

 - Partner with the Head of Talent Development and People Partners to plan and execute strategic talent & culture projects as they arise — from culture initiatives to ad hoc organizational assessments.

 - Build repeatable playbooks, templates, and documentation for recurring programs; identify opportunities to automate and streamline workflows (survey comms, reminders, action-plan collection, reporting) using AI-enabled tools.

 - Partner closely with HRBPs, HR Leadership, and business leaders to ensure programs are well adopted, inclusive, and grounded in what the data shows; act as the day-to-day point of contact for program questions and escalations.

 - Stay current on market practice in organizational effectiveness, engagement measurement, and change management, bringing external benchmarks and frameworks into program design.

Job Requirements

 - Bachelor’s degree.

 - 5–7+ years of relevant experience in organizational effectiveness, program management, people analytics / insights, employee engagement, or change management, ideally in a fast-paced or tech environment.

 - Proven experience owning an end-to-end engagement survey program (design, launch, reporting, action planning) or comparable organizational diagnostic work.

 - Working knowledge of change management frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR or equivalent); Prosci or CCMP certification a plus.

 - Demonstrated proficiency in people analytics and data storytelling — comfortable working with survey, org health, and HRIS data, and consolidating it into dashboards and reporting views for leaders.

 - Experience supporting operating model or org design work (roles, structures, decision rights) a plus.

 - Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs, build clear project plans, manage dependencies, and deliver on time.

 - High proficiency with project management, collaboration, survey, and analytics tools.

 - Experience using AI or automation tools to streamline workflows or strong aptitude to learn.

 - Excellent written, verbal, and facilitation skills, with the ability to tell a clear, effective story with data and translate complex data and diagnostics into actionable guidance for leadership.

 - Strong stakeholder management skills, the ability to influence without authority, and build trust across People sub-teams and business partners.

 - High attention to detail and ownership, and comfort operating with a mix of structure and ambiguity as programs evolve.

About Socure

Socure is the leading provider of digital identity verification and fraud solutions, powering the world’s largest financial institutions, fintechs, and digital brands. Our mission is to verify 100% of good identities in real time while eliminating identity fraud for every application on the internet. The People Team at Socure is building a high-performance, AI-enabled, and human-centered workplace, and this role plays a critical part in how we set, support, and sustain that performance and organizational health through scalable programs and data-informed insight.

The Sr. Program Manager, Performance is a strategic, hands-on program owner responsible for designing, running, and continuously improving Socure’s performance operating system.

Reporting to the Head of Talent Development & OE, this role owns end-to-end delivery of goal-setting, check-ins, continuous feedback, recognition, and performance reviews, and partners closely on the talent planning work that draws on that data — calibration, talent mapping, and action planning. Socure is searching for a Head of Growth Engineering—an entrepreneurial leader who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product, marketing, and go-to-market. In this high-impact role, you’ll define and lead the systems, team, and experimentation engine that power how Socure creates demand, personalizes pipeline, and unlocks customer acquisition across multiple verticals.

This is a rare opportunity to build a new function at the frontier of AI-native growth. You’ll architect the operating model, shape the roadmap, and build the infrastructure that enables faster experimentation, sharper targeting, and more scalable customer engagement. You’re equal parts builder, strategist, and operator: someone who can zoom out to define the vision, then dive in to ship, test, and iterate with speed.

You’ll lead the kind of team great growth marketers and engineers want to be part of—hands-on, deeply curious, data-obsessed, and relentlessly focused on measurable business impact. If you’re excited to build the future of growth through automation, AI, and high-leverage systems, this is your moment. You won’t just support growth—you’ll engineer the function that scales it.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Define and lead Socure’s growth engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap across acquisition, activation, conversion, and expansion.

 - Build and mentor a high-performing growth engineering team, setting a high bar for experimentation, technical quality, speed, and business impact.

 - Scale sales and marketing through automation, AI assistance, and accessible insights that improve execution across GTM.

 - Architect and own the systems that power campaign automation, lifecycle journeys, personalization, lead routing, and new GTM workflows.

 - Build and operationalize AI agents that accelerate campaign creation, prospecting, onboarding, customer communication, and cross-sell motions.

 - Launch full-stack growth experiments, interactive landing pages, calculators, demos, and lightweight products that drive pipeline, organic traffic, and referrals.

 - Design innovative outbound and prospecting systems using tools like Clay, GenAI agents, enrichment platforms, and web automation tools.

 - Partner with marketing, RevOps, partnerships, product, and sales leadership to align growth experiments with commercial priorities and pipeline goals.

 - Establish a rigorous experimentation program, including A/B testing frameworks, measurement plans, decision criteria, and rapid iteration loops.

 - Build the data and reporting layer that helps RevOps and Marketing Ops better understand funnel performance, attribution, and behavioral signals.

 - Create reusable playbooks, internal tools, and AI-powered workflows that act as force multipliers for GTM teams across the business.

 - Monitor market shifts, competitive signals, and customer sentiment to inform positioning, messaging, and growth opportunities.

 - Lead the development of self-service growth experiences with elegant UX, dynamic messaging, and measurable conversion outcomes.

 - Continuously evaluate new tools, platforms, and AI capabilities, bringing the best ideas in-house to strengthen Socure’s growth engine.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Strong full-stack technical fluency, with experience building production-quality experiments, internal tools, automations, or growth systems using technologies such as JavaScript, Python, and modern front-end frameworks.

 - Deep experience with APIs, webhooks, data integrations, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Retool, Make, or similar tools.

 - Hands-on experience with growth and outbound platforms such as Clay, Apollo, Clearbit, Instantly, or similar tools, including multi-step enrichment, segmentation, and activation workflows.

 - Working knowledge of SQL, audience logic, instrumentation, and funnel analysis to measure performance and guide optimization.

 - Strong systems thinking with the ability to connect product, marketing, and GTM infrastructure into scalable operating workflows.


AI-DRIVEN GROWTH

 - Proven experience building or integrating AI agents, copilots, or LLM-powered workflows that improve speed, personalization, and efficiency across GTM motions.

 - Fluency with modern AI tooling such as ChatGPT, Claude, embeddings-based workflows, and prompt-driven systems for content generation, research, and orchestration.

 - Ability to design scalable messaging systems that adapt by vertical, use case, persona, and buying signal without sacrificing quality or clarity.


LEADERSHIP & GROWTH STRATEGY

 - Track record of defining and leading growth experiments across acquisition, onboarding, activation, retention, or expansion.

 - Experience building or leading cross-functional teams, with the ability to recruit strong talent, coach effectively, and create clarity in ambiguous environments.

 - Strong judgment in prioritizing what to build, what to test, and what to scale based on measurable business impact.

 - Deep understanding of demand generation, brand storytelling, lifecycle marketing, GTM personalization, and the mechanics of modern funnel optimization.

 - A builder’s mindset with a bias toward action, a love of experimentation, and a high bar for both velocity and quality.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, identity, fraud, risk, or similarly complex regulated markets.

 - Experience building growth systems that serve multiple industries, verticals, or product lines with tailored messaging and workflows.

 - Familiarity with CRM and marketing systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, Segment, or similar platforms.

jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.




OVERVIEW

Socure is seeking an Analyst, GRC – Public Sector to own the hands-on execution of the company’s governance, risk, and compliance operations for its public sector business. Reporting to the Director of GRC – Public Sector, this role is responsible day-to-day for running FedRAMP/GovRAMP continuous monitoring, building and maintaining the POA&M and compliance trackers that keep the program audit-ready, and coordinating access reviews, vulnerability remediation, and evidence collection with Security, Engineering, IT, DevOps, Product, Legal, and other teams. As the Analyst builds fluency in these operational fundamentals, the role grows to include drafting customer-facing compliance and RFP response content that makes Socure’s security posture compelling to public sector buyers, and pursuing automation-first, system-driven improvements, including machine-readable formats like OSCAL and AI-enabled workflows, that reduce manual effort and challenge how the team has traditionally done this work.




ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES


COMPLIANCE & CERTIFICATION MANAGEMENT

 - Day-to-day coordination and execution of externalThird Party Assessment Organization (3PAO) assessments and responding to auditor requests for evidence and documentation.

 - Maintain and update FedRAMP and GovRAMP controls and documentation in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements, including controls aligned with NIST SP 800-53 rev 5 and other related frameworks.

 - Prepare certification and authorization packages and maintain related documentation such as the System Security Plan (SSP) and associated appendices.

 - Replace manual evidence collection with system-generated, API-driven, or continuously validated evidence where possible. Build and maintain the trackers, procedures, and status-reporting artifacts that operationalize this work, structured so other stakeholders can use them directly.


CONTINUOUS MONITORING & VULNERABILITY MANAGEMENT

 - Design and evolve an automation-first continuous monitoring program leveraging system integrations, telemetry, and real-time data pipelines

 - Lead the day-to-day FedRAMP continuous monitoring process including vulnerability management lifecycle, from identification through remediation and verification, coordinating with Security, Engineering, and DevOps teams to address issues identified with tools such as Wiz, Burp Suite, AWS native services, and other platforms and resolve issues within FedRAMP and GovRAMP timelines.

 - Coordinate recurring continuous monitoring compliance activities such as access reviews, incident response exercises, and contingency plan testing.


ACCESS MANAGEMENT & TRAINING

 - Design scalable and automated access validation mechanisms integrated with identity and infrastructure systems

 - Design, implement and deliver FedRAMP training programs to promote compliance awareness

 - Create and manage automated workflows to improve efficiency.


AUDIT & ASSESSMENT READINESS

 - Transform compliance evidence from static repositories into dynamic, system-driven evidence models supporting real-time audit readiness

 - Conduct internal reviews of logged events and control activities, escalating issues or gaps to the Director of GRC and provide status updates and reports highlighting trends, risks, and remediation progress.


PROCESS IMPROVEMENT & COLLABORATION

 - Collaborate with the Director of GRC to design automation-first and AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort and enable scalable compliance operations

 - Support the development, rollout, and maintenance of machine-readable compliance documentation (e.g., OSCAL or comparable structured formats) to facilitate interoperability

 - Partner with automation and engineering teams to integrate structured compliance data into Socure’s broader risk management and monitoring ecosystem including vulnerability remediation, access requests, and compliance reporting.

 - Monitor regulatory and industry trends for potential impacts to compliance strategy.


PUBLIC SECTOR SALES & CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT

 - Serve as a security subject matter expert for public sector sales activities, translating compliance controls and system capabilities into clear, accurate, and compelling customer-facing narratives. The Analyst is expected to learn the difference between writing that confirms Socure meets a requirement and writing that persuades a public sector buyer that Socure’s approach is comfortable and superior to competitors’, with the Director retaining final review and approval given the contractual and sales stakes.

 - Support development of external communications such as press releases and customer-facing materials related to security certifications and authorizations.

 - Build and maintain scalable response frameworks (e.g., answer libraries, structured content, or AI-assisted tools) to provide consistency, accuracy, and speed across RFP and RFx responses


MONITOR EVOLVING REQUIREMENTS

 - Monitor new and evolving requirements and perform gap analyses including
   
   - Updates to applicable NIST Special Publications and other government standards
   
   - Contract security requirements from new customers
   
   - Updates to the FedRAMP Program requirements and processes as the program evolves

 - Provide input to standards bodies on evolving standards when applicable


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years of hands-on cybersecurity, compliance, or identity-management experience, including demonstrated personal execution of FedRAMP, GovRAMP, or comparable continuous-monitoring work — running scans, building or maintaining a POA&M, and preparing deviation requests. Public sector experience is a plus but not required.

 - Direct experience with FedRAMP, GovRAMP, and NIST frameworks (800-53, 800-63, 800-171).

 - Proven ability to personally execute continuous monitoring, vulnerability remediation, and compliance reporting.

 - Proven ability to design and improve repeatable compliance processes - identifying inefficiencies, defining clear steps, and building structure where none exists; experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Glean, Gemini) and machine-readable formats (e.g., OSCAL) to accelerate that work is a strong plus.

 - Strong communication, organization, and collaboration skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, including strong written communication and the ability to write persuasively for a customer audience — distinct from writing that is merely compliance-accurate.

 - Ability to adapt to changing requirements

 - Demonstrated customer-facing experience and enough exposure to product or sales positioning to distinguish compliance-accurate writing from writing that persuades a buyer; prior RFP-specific experience is not required.

 - Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. Citizens or U.S. Permanent Residents) residing in the United States and be able to obtain a U.S. OPM NACI clearance.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in regulated industries (e.g., financial services, healthcare) and knowledge of privacy and compliance frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, and key NIST standards.

 - Professional certifications preferred (CISSP, CISM, CISA, IAPP).

 - Proven hands-on contribution to certification and compliance initiatives (FedRAMP, GovRAMP, NIST 800-63/171).

 - Skilled in continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, policy updates, and audit coordination across cross-functional teams. Also valued: a demonstrated track record of identifying and closing process gaps proactively, without waiting for direction.

 - Strong understanding of evolving cybersecurity standards and digital identity regulations, with the ability to translate them into practical risk and compliance improvements.

jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.



Senior Technical Content Writer - Job Description

 

About the role

This is an employment marketing role for someone who can make exceptional engineers want to work at Socure. Socure is building AI-native infrastructure for identity, fraud prevention, and trust, and we need your help getting that engineering story out to the places where great technical talent discovers ideas, follows builders, and finds its next challenge.

You will work closely with engineers, technical leaders, recruiting, and marketing to turn APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, and decisioning workflows into a compelling case for joining the team. Your work will show software engineers the problems they can solve here, the systems they can help build, and the ambition behind Socure's mission.

 

Why this role matters

The best engineers are not looking for generic employer branding. They are looking for hard technical problems, strong peers, meaningful architecture, and a mission worth their time. You will make those things visible - in the communities, publications, developer platforms, social channels, and other talent-rich spaces where engineers actually pay attention.

 

What you will do

Tell the engineering story

 - Interview engineers and technical leaders, learn how the platform works, and turn real technical work into stories that make top engineers lean in.

 - Write technical content - including engineering blogs, deep dives, architecture stories, technical whitepapers, and recruiting-facing website copy - that makes the work at Socure tangible.

Reach engineers where they are

 - Own an employment-marketing content calendar built around the channels and communities where software engineers discover work, exchange ideas, and decide which companies deserve their attention.

 - Adapt and distribute stories across developer platforms, technical publications, engineering communities, social channels, and other high-signal places where the best talent gathers.

 - Partner with recruiting and employer brand to connect content to talent goals, strengthen candidate interest, and support hard-to-fill engineering hiring.

Make difficult technology compelling

 - Translate APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, decisioning workflows, and cloud-based architectures into accurate, engaging stories for technical audiences.

 - Show why the problems matter, what makes Socure's approach distinctive, and what an engineer could help build next.

Build real subject matter depth

 - Develop enough understanding of Socure's products and platform to write with authority, ask sharp questions, and earn the trust of technical experts.

 - Stay current on AI, fraud, identity, security, and infrastructure trends, and turn them into timely points of view that attract the right people.

How you will work

Collaborate across the company

 - Work with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and technical subject matter experts to find the strongest stories and get them ready for the right audiences.

 - Partner with design, social, and distribution teams to package and place content for reach, credibility, and candidate action.

 - Build a repeatable feedback loop with engineers so the content stays technically honest and genuinely representative of the work.

Raise the bar

 - Protect a high editorial standard for clarity, accuracy, voice, and consistency across every channel.

 - Edit and proofread content from other contributors, and help maintain Socure's content style guide.

Use AI thoughtfully

 - Use AI tools such as ChatGPT's Deep Research to accelerate research, drafting, and technical enablement while keeping human judgment, verification, and editorial quality at the center.

 

What you bring

 - Demonstrable experience in content writing, technical writing, employer brand, recruiting marketing, or content marketing, ideally in identity verification, fraud, cybersecurity, fintech, infrastructure, or another technical B2B SaaS environment.

 - Strong technical curiosity and the ability to learn and write accurately about APIs, machine learning, and cloud-based architectures.

 - Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with a talent for making complex technical work clear, credible, and exciting to software engineers.

 - A portfolio of published technical, engineering, employer-brand, or recruiting content, such as blogs, deep dives, whitepapers, case studies, or similar work.

 - Experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and subject matter experts.

 - Strong editorial and distribution instincts, with comfort owning a content calendar, finding the right audience and channel, giving and receiving feedback, and maintaining a consistent voice.

 - Experience using AI tools for research, drafting, and content production is a plus.

 
 

If you can understand ambitious engineering work, find the audience that will appreciate it, and make great engineers curious enough to start a conversation, we want to hear from you.
